Trayage 1.1 (7)

A new look shaped by your feedback, with more ways to give Downloads a second look.

  • A new tray icon, violet colors, and a redesigned overview in light and dark modes.
  • Choose Glance or Quick review for your menu bar.
  • Start with 14 smart-filter presets or save your own All/Any rules. Preview matches and pin favorites.
  • Hide suggestions while keeping their files, and restore hidden suggestions in Settings.
  • Compare likely duplicate downloads locally and set optional folder-size reminders.
  • Clearer Settings and Billing, text sizes up to 200%, and visible refresh feedback.
  • A personal thank-you from Kyle, available again in About.

File review stays on your Mac. Nothing is selected or removed automatically: you choose files and confirm before they move to Trash. Trayage never empties Trash.

This is the direct-download edition for macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Your existing settings and direct license stay with your installation. Stripe checkout and Keylight licenses remain unchanged; Apple purchases are separate.

Trayage 1.0 (4)

  • Check for updates from the app menu, menu-bar popover, General settings, or About.
  • Opt into daily update checks while Trayage is running. Review what changed and choose when to download and install.
  • Updates and the update feed are signed, and the app is notarized by Apple.
  • Fixes switching from Light to Device appearance so billing controls follow your Mac’s appearance.

Your existing settings and direct license stay with your installation. This update does not change your purchase terms.
